title: Stack Profile Schema
description: Per-hub declared technology/capability profile constraining degraded_capabilities[] (glossary row of docs/designs/2026-11-01-hub-consolidation-design.md; the never-in-DEGRADED floor is defined once in docs/designs/2026-11-01-coworkspace-attach-mode-design.md SS4 and cited normatively by hub_topology.capability_enum). Authored per hub as stack-profile.json in the hub program's Batch E; this schema is the delivery contract. Lives beside variant.schema.json (L0 docs/templates/, same tier) — a schema contract, not a per-variant authored file.

name.description: Hub/project identifier this profile describes (matches variant.json name)

description.description: Human-readable summary of the declared stack and its delivery scope

stack.description: Declared technologies/runtimes the hub's deliverables are built on (e.g. bun, typescript, xlsx). Free-form names — the capability constraint below is what the state machine enforces

capabilities.description: Capability keys this hub may declare or degrade, constrained to hub_topology.capability_enum keys (docs/workspace-schema.json). A hub cannot declare — and cannot degrade into — a capability the root schema does not know (design SS3.4); entries with never_in_degraded: true may never appear in a DEGRADED declaration

commands.description: Canonical build/test/lint/deploy commands for the hub's deliverables. Consumers (delegation tickets, hub-bootstrap VALIDATED gate) run these verbatim from the hub repo root.

deploy.description: Deploy/publish command; omit when the hub ships no deployable runtime

artifacts.description: Artifact structure: the deliverables this stack produces, where they land, and their kind

path.description: Project-relative artifact path or glob (e.g. dist/report.xlsx); must resolve inside the hub repo

kind.description: Artifact class used by delegation routing and probe reports

description.description: What the artifact contains and who consumes it

handoffs.description: Handoff mappings: producer-to-consumer contracts between pipeline stages or agents

artifact.description: Artifact path handed over (should match an artifacts[].path entry)

trigger.description: When the handoff fires (workflow phase, event, or gate)

notes.description: Free-text notes (constraints, environment prerequisites, known limitations)
